sloka: त्वं हि शक्तस्तारयितुं सेन्द्रानपि दिवौकसः ।तस्मात्प्रदास्ये विधिवत्तत्प्रतीच्छ नराधिप ।। ७.७६.३२ ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ hi śaktastārayituṁ sendrānapi divaukasaḥ ।tasmātpradāsye vidhivattatpratīccha narādhipa ।। 7.76.32 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, you are capable of protecting even the gods, including Indra, therefore I will properly give this to you; O king of men, please accept it.
